text: During lactation, intense work, or recovery of body condition in a thin animal, forage alone is often not enough. Options include buying high-value forage (King Grass, Guinea Grass, Napier Grass, or foliages like Erythrina and Leucaena) or making a Home Made Concentrate (HMC) that packs more nutrients into a smaller feed volume. Example HMC recipe: 12 kg rice bran, 7 kg dried cassava chip, 3 kg cassava hay, 0.3 kg urea, 0.25 kg salt, 0.25 kg palm sugar. To prepare: mix all components carefully by hand; dissolve the palm sugar in water first, then sprinkle it over the pile and mix well. Feeding guide: 200 g/day improves the diet of a 200 kg animal; 500 g/day supports hard work or milk production; 1–2 kg/day for about 6 weeks supports fattening before sale — split the daily amount between morning and evening.
